Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! India players make their way out in the middle. Followed by Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start with the ball. Here we go...

Sri Lanka's bowling was superb! Dushmantha Chameera started it all picking up Shaw off the very first ball of the game with a beauty of a delivery. He was brilliant at the death too but it was Wanindu Hasaranga again who was the pick of the bowlers as he simply bamboozled the Indian batsmen. Akila Dananjaya was expensive while Chamika Karunaratne was once again impressive. Their death bowling was exceptional as they used the slower balls to perfection. Now they would look to bat well and chase this total down. Do join us in a while for the run chase.
Short of a length on middle, Krunal Pandya pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 7 runs from the last over. INDIA FINISH WITH 164/5.

India at one stage looked like they will get more than 164 but some smart bowling towards the end has restricted them. India lost Prithvi Shaw first ball but then Sanju Samson and Shikhar Dhawan stitched a very good partnership before Samson threw it away. Suryakumar Yadav looked in sublime touch once again as he scored a 50 but then gave his wicket away. Shikhar Dhawan looked good too but Hardik Pandya struggled once again to get going while Kishan played some good shots but India could not finish with a flurry.

Very good finish from Sri Lanka! They will be extremely pleased with their effort and they would fancy themselves to chase it down. India, on the other hand, will be slightly disappointed and they need to come out all guns blazing with the ball if they want to defend this.
WIDE! Way too outside off, Pandya leaves it alone. Wided.
Full and outside off, Kishan smacks it towards long off for one.
Full and outside off, Kishan steers it towards deep point for a couple of runs. Can India finish on a high?
Touch fuller on off, Pandya hits it towards long on for one.
Full toss wide outside off, Kishan works it towards square leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Kishan pushes it towards wide of long off. He calls for two and gets it with ease.
Chamika Karunaratne will bowl the final over.
Very full around off, Kishan eases it to mid off for one.
On a length outside off, Krunal Pandya pushes it towards point for a single.
Krunal Pandya is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Length delivery on off, Hardik Pandya looks to cut but misses. The ball takes the outside edge and Minod Bhanuka behind the sticks does the rest. Hardik Pandya didn't quite look in touch today and has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Minod Bhanuka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Length delivery on middle, Ishan Kishan prods and heaves it towards deep square leg. He doesn't quite middle it though. The fielder at the deep runs across and attempts to take the catch but spills it out. A single taken.
Full toss on middle, Pandya knocks it to long on for one.
Fires a yorker on middle, Pandya jams it out towards deep point for a couple of runs.
TWO WIDES! Short ball on middle, Ishan Kishan ducks under it. The keeper fails to collect the ball and the batters steal an extra run.
Length ball on middle, Kishan tucks it towards square leg for one.
SIX! KABOOM! It has come at the right time for India! Right into the arc of Ishan Kishan, he makes room for himself and powers it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower one again on middle, Pandya waits for it and muscles it to long on but only for a single. Boundaries aren't coming for India at the moment.
Length ball on middle, nudged towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Slower delivery outside off, Pandya looks to cut it away but fails to connect anything on it.
Isuru Udana returns into the attack.
Length ball on off, Pandya taps it to point for a single.
On a length on middle, took the pace off. Kishan looks to work it on the leg side but misses. He gets hit on the shoulders and takes a run of leg bye.
FOUR! Well played! Full toss outside off, Ishan Kishan opens the face of the bat and carves it towards deep point for a boundary.
Bangs a short ball on middle, Kishan sways away from it.
Length delivery outside off, Kishan drives it straight to extra cover.
Length ball on middle, Pandya works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on.
Floated it up on off, Pandya cuts it to point for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Kishan tucks it on the leg side for one.
Slower outside off, Pandya pushes it towards cover-point for one.
Flatter outside off, Pandya blocks it out.
Ishan Kishan comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fifty and out for Suryakumar Yadav. Tossed up on off, Suryakumar Yadav looks to heave it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball goes high up in the air towards long off. The substitute fielder Ramesh Mendis settles under it and pouches it comfortably. End of a great knock from Suryakumar Yadav. He is disappointed as he walks back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Ramesh Mendis b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Tossed up on off, Suryakumar Yadav prods and heaves it over long on for a biggie. Brings up his fifty as well.
Good length ball on off, Pandya pushes it to cover.
Slower ball outside off, Yadav cuts it to deep point for a single.
Short ball outside off, Yadav plays it to short third man.
SIX! Hammered! Full and outside off, Yadav shuffles across and then lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Slower ball outside off, Yadav looks to cut but misses.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Suryakumar Yadav looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Hardik Pandya walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chamika Karunaratne has his first T20I wicket and it is of the big one, Shikhar Dhawan. Short ball around middle, Dhawan dances down the track and then looks to pull but does not make the best of connections. It goes to Ashen Bandara at deep square leg who accepts it gleefully.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashen Bandara b Chamika Karunaratne

Full on the pads, Yadav flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Dhawan defends it to cover for a single.

Flatter ball on middle, Yadav tucks it to long on for one.
Good length ball on middle, Yadav nudges it down to long on for one.

Falls just short! Good length ball around off, Yadav looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes to point where it falls short.

Good length ball outside off, Yadav looks to cut but it goes off the gloves to the off side. A single taken.
FOUR! Brilliant batting from Suryakumar Yadav! Full on middle, Yadav waits for it and then paddle scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.

On pads, Dhawan tucks it  to square leg for one.
Loopy ball on off, Yadav flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Yadav cuts it to point.

OUT! LBW! Wanindu Hasaranga gets a wicket off the first ball! Flatter and quicker delivery on middle, Sanju Samson takes a stride forward and looks to defend it. He misses it and gets rapped up on the front pad. Wanindu Hasaranga knew it that it is plumb and straightaway appeals for an LBW. The umpire raises his finger without any hesitation. He is pumped up!
Wanindu Hasaranga comes into the attack now.
Drifting down the leg, Samson tucks it towards mid-wicket. He keeps the strike taking a single. End of the Powerplay. India are 51/1.
Floated it up on middle, patted back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on middle, nudged towards deep mid-wicket. Shikhar Dhawan calls for the second run and gets it with ease. Excellent running between the wickets. 50 up for India as well.
Flighted delivery on middle, Samson nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Samson you beauty! Tossed up on off, Sanju Samson creams it through covers for a boundary.

1Full on middle, Dhawan nudges it to mid on for a single.

NOT OUT! It has bounced in front and Samson survives! Full outside off, Samson smacks it to cover where Fernando bends down and seems to have taken it. He claims it and starts celebrating. Samson though is not going anywhere. The two umpires converge and take it upstairs. The soft signal is not out. The replays roll in and they show that it has bounced before the fielder takes it.

Is that a catch? Sanju Samson is not walking back. The umpire has taken it upstairs and the soft signal is NOT OUT. The third umpire sees the replay and signals the same on the TV screen as the ball bounced just before Avishka Fernando grabbed it.
Full outside off, Dhawan lifts it to deep cover for one.
Isuru Udana comes into the attack.

That would have been close! Floated on the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side and takes off for a single. The fielder collects and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
An appeal for LBW turned down! Flatter on the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire says no.

Chamika Karunaratne to bowl from the opposite end.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a start and what a delivery from Dushmantha Chameera. A duck on T20I debut for Prithvi Shaw and Sri Lanka are off to a brilliant start. Full and around off, swinging away. Shaw looks to push at it but gets an outside edge and goes to the right of Minod Bhanuka who pouches it. Perfect delivery.
Commentary.Howout: c Minod Bhanuka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: We are set to begin! The Sri Lanka players form a huddle and stride out to the middle. Shikhar Dhawan and Prithvi Shaw will open for India. Dushmantha Chameera to open the attack for Sri Lanka. Here we go...
All set for the National Anthems! Both teams are out in the middle. India's is up first followed by Sri Lanka's.

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Prithvi Shaw, Ishan Kishan (WK0, Suryakumar Yadav, Sanju Samson (WK), Hardik Pandya, Krunal Pandya, Deepak Chahar, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Yuzvendra Chahal, Varun Chakravarthy.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) -  Avishka Fernando, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Ashen Bandara, Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Isuru Udana, Akila Dananjaya, Dushmantha Chameera.

Shikhar Dhawan, the Indian skipper, says that they would have bowled first but they are capable enough to get a big score. Adds that it is about giving an opportunity to new players and see how they can perform at the international level. States that they have Shaw and Chakravarthy as debutants and also informs that they have got plenty of changes.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper, says they will bowl first. Adds that the wicket will be good for the latter part of the game. Adds that the injuries are uncontrollable and he can't do anything about it. Mentions that there are three changes from the last ODI.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Sri Lanka. They are going to bowl first.
Pitch report - There is grass on this wicket and it looks similar to what it was in the T20Is. Adds that it looks a flat wicket and there might be plenty of runs on offer.

There is some movement in the Indian camp as they have handed out caps to Prithvi Shaw who is set to play his first T20I game and the other debutant is Varun Chakravarthy. It has been a long wait for the spinner who has been in the Indian squad before but due to fitness concerns, he has not got his opportunity and this is a good opportunity for him to make a case.

We have some news coming in as the Indian T20 League is all set to resume on September 19 in the UAE starting with the clash between Mumbai and Chennai in Dubai. The League stages will end on 8th October and the Playoffs will start on 10th October and the Final will be played on 15th October. Great news, ain't it?

Chetan Sakariya is there for a chat. He says that he worked hard in the last year or so. Adds that he is feeling very happy representing India. Tells that he likes T20s as he can use his variations. States that he has learnt some new things in his bowling and now he has started to bowl outswing to the right-handers. Tells that he is focussing on his skills. States that he enjoys batting as well.

Shikhar Dhawan has led the team well so far and he would look to continue the good job. He though now has his eyes on the T20 World Cup and he wants to be a part of that squad. Dhawan had a tough series against England in March but he was in great touch in the Indian T20 League which was postponed in May. Now he has a chance to make a case for himself and he surely would not want to miss out on the opportunity.

How are the preparations for the T20 World Cup going? Well for India, they won their last T20I series against England in March while Sri Lanka recently lost to England in England. India have some inexperienced players in their squad this time around but they are still a strong unit and the players will look to make their case for the T20 World Cup later in the year. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, are missing some of their key players for various reasons but and it has been a tough year for them so far and they would want to start getting back on winning ways.

After an enthralling ODI series, it is now time for some T20I action. After losing the first two ODIs, the Islanders made a great comeback in the third ODI and that shall give boost their confidence coming to this T20I series. On the flip side, India though lost the third ODI, the Men in Blue will back themselves to make a good start to this series as the side definitely have the young guns in their troop. So hello and good evening for the first T20I where Sri Lanka will take on India.
